operations.credit_rule_for_next_section: Only concepts with state USABLE may be assumed in S10. PARTIAL, MENTION_ONLY, MISCONCEPTION_RISK and MISSING receive no automatic prerequisite credit.

effective_campaign_state.note_on_counts: Running local counts only. Mandatory global passes may merge recurring root causes, reject false positives or change severity when later dependency evidence is available.

S10_entry_watchlist: S10 is the canonical module/import/packaging/CLI section. Imports used repeatedly in S01-S09 remain MENTION_ONLY and cannot be treated as mastered.
S10 must explicitly repair process exit semantics. S08 and S09 both caught fatal exceptions, printed labels such as exit != 0/fatal/abort, and nevertheless terminated with actual process status 0.
The S10 CLI boundary must separate library exceptions, top-level exception handling, stderr/stdout and observable non-zero exit status. Logging an error is not equivalent to failing the process.
if __name__ == '__main__' appeared in S01 but remains MENTION_ONLY; S10 must teach it from first principles.
Traceback reading, fail-fast and log.exception remain MISCONCEPTION_RISK from S09 and cannot be silently assumed in CLI error-handler examples.
Logging levels are USABLE, but structured LogRecord fields, correlation propagation and PII-safe exception logging are not.
Custom exception classes remain MENTION_ONLY because class/inheritance semantics are canonically S11. S10 should not use OO scaffolding as a hidden prerequisite.
JSON, provenance and deterministic manifest semantics remain PARTIAL/MISCONCEPTION_RISK from S08; configuration examples need local bridges.
Idempotency and retry remain MISCONCEPTION_RISK; S10 commands must not assume retry safety merely because S09 displayed a retry helper.
CP-N1-C/CASO identifiers remain a persistent widow-term family unless expanded globally.
